title: Devil Rider
description: After people are killed in horrible ways on a ranch, the residents wonder if a monster from hell has returned with a hunger for human flesh.

title: Traded
description: In the 1880s Kansas, a gunman turned rancher travels to Wichita and Dodge City to find his runaway daughter.

title: The Proud Rebel
description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

title: Pancho Villa
description: This mostly fictional account follows the trigger-happy Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa (Telly Savalas) in his attempt to kill bitter nemesis Gen. Goyo and overthrow Mexico's government. The violent endeavor brings Villa north to New Mexico, where he battles a group of determined American soldiers led by the no-nonsense Col. Wilcox (Chuck Connors), and endures unanticipated mishaps and bad fortune, including a double-cross by his friend and partner, Scotty (Clint Walker).

title: A Reckoning
description: A widowed homesteader leaves everything behind to hunt her husband's killer.

title: Death Ranch
description: Three siblings wage bloody war against sadistic members of the Ku Klux Klan in 1971 Tennessee.

title: The Star Packer
description: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

title: Boon
description: Mercenary Nick Boon is trying to atone for his life as an enforcer for a ruthless syndicate. Running from his past, Boon moves to a remote area in the Pacific Northwest, where he meets a struggling widow and her son. When he finds the pair living in fear of a criminal kingpin, Boon realizes the only way to protect them is to do what he does best.

title: The Ballad of Davy Crockett
description: After his wife falls ill, legendary American hero Davy Crockett treks across a savage wilderness to save his sons from the clutches of an evil land baron.

title: Buffalo Girls
description: Calamity Jane and her illustrious cohorts travel the wild west in search of her long-lost daughter and the west they once knew.

title: Buffalo Girls
description: Calamity Jane and her illustrious cohorts travel the wild west in search of her long-lost daughter and the west they once knew.

title: The Quick and the Dead
description: A mysterious stranger (Sam Elliott) befriends and protects a settler (Tom Conti) and his wife (Kate Capshaw) in 1876 Wyoming.

title: Echoes of War
description: A Civil War veteran takes matters into his own hands when neighboring ranchers steal animals from his family's traps.

title: The Outsider
description: A railroad worker unwittingly finds himself on the wrong side of a group of corrupt lawmen in the Old West. When tragedy forces him to seek justice, he soon sets out on a bloody quest for revenge to wipe out his ruthless enemies.

title: The First Seal Revelations
description: A never-before-told story with a unique style and presentation of symbolic beings all surrounding a pure Spanish horse. Music scoring that enhances the film with a modern tone. A thought-provoking message empowering one's own beliefs.

title: The Young Land
description: A white man (Dennis Hopper) stands trial for killing a Mexican in 1848 California, just after the Mexican War.

title: Guns for Hire
description: Beatle, a tower and assassin, has her life as a loner changed when she meets Althena, a suicidal blonde woman with a secret. Beatle agrees to execute Althena, and as they wait for the paperwork to come through, the two become roommates.

title: The Painted Hills
description: A determined prospector, Jonathan Harvey (Paul Kelly) finds gold after years of searching. When he returns to town to tell his partner, Jonathan finds that his friend has died, leaving his son, Tommy (Gary Gray), on his own. While Jonathan's loyal collie, Lassie, stays with the boy, he goes to find help to assist him with his lucrative discovery. However, the new recruit (Bruce Cowling) proves to be a shady character, and before long the ruthless schemer has incurred the wrath of Lassie.

title: The Last Posse
description: Wealthy rancher Sampson Drune is resented by members of the Romer family, who feel he swindled them out of their cattle. They retaliate by robbing Drune and fleeing with the money. Drune organizes a posse of townspeople and asks alcoholic Sheriff John Frazier to deputize the group. They head out in search of the bandits with Frazier in tow. Two days later, the Romers and Drune are dead, Frazier is wounded, and the money has disappeared.

title: Alien Showdown: The Day the Old West Stood Still
description: In 1854, a lone cowboy is forced to battle an alien scout before it can call in an invasion fleet.

title: Bordertown
description: Lauren Adrian (Jennifer Lopez), a Chicago reporter, travels to Mexico to investigate the unsolved murders of hundreds of Mexican women taking place over the years near an American-owned factory. Lauren reunites with Alfonso Diaz (Antonio Banderas), her former lover and colleague, who publicizes the murders despite threats from local authorities. Together the pair seek the truth and try to help the survivor (Maya Zapata) of a brutal attack find justice.

title: Lonesome Dove
description: Two former Texas Rangers renew their spirit of adventure as they and other residents of a Texas town join a cattle drive to the Montana Territory.
